purpose: Build versioned TMDB identity, structured feature, and text embedding artifacts without using TMDB popularity as preference evidence.

inputs.candidate_core: outputs/recommendation-evidence/rec-ev-019a/candidate-core-provisional.parquet when available; otherwise all Base-Train movie IDs derived with the 019A contract
inputs.tmdb_auth_accepted_shapes: JWT Read Access Token uses Authorization Bearer; 32-character v3 API key uses api_key query transport only; neither is serialized

candidate_derivation.movie_rule: distinct movieId observed for at least one Base-Train user
candidate_derivation.linked_definition: links.csv tmdbId parses as a positive integer
candidate_derivation.preflight_sample_algorithm: sort linked movies by SHA256('feelm-rec-019b-sample-v1|' + canonical movieId), then take N

tmdb_extraction.english_fallback_request: repeat details request with language=en-US only when the ko-KR title or overview is blank
tmdb_extraction.imdb_recovery_rule: only after a linked tmdbId returns 404 or 410; accept exactly one movie_result and then fetch its movie details

identity_rules.ML_TMDB_VERIFIED: details response id equals linked tmdbId and any nonblank returned imdb_id equals links.csv imdbId
identity_rules.RECOVERED_BY_IMDB: find-by-imdb returns exactly one movie and recovered details id matches that movie id
identity_rules.TYPE_MISMATCH_TV: find-by-imdb returns no movie result and at least one tv result
identity_rules.TMDB_NOT_FOUND: terminal details response and find-by-imdb returns no movie or tv result
identity_rules.IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: ambiguous movie results, response id mismatch, or nonblank imdb mismatch

language_merge.display_title: first nonblank of ko-KR title, en-US title, original_title
language_merge.overview_fallback: first nonblank of ko-KR overview, en-US overview
language_merge.structured_lists: use the verified/recovered primary details response; language labels are for embedding text only
language_merge.director_rule: crew job exactly Director, preserve credit order, unique person id
language_merge.cast_rule: sort by order then person id, unique person id, take first five
language_merge.keyword_rule: accept keywords.keywords or keywords.results, preserve response order, unique keyword id

tmdb_extraction.structured_feature_eligible: identity eligible and original_language, release_year, and at least one genre id are present
tmdb_extraction.text_feature_eligible: identity eligible and display_title and overview_fallback are nonblank
tmdb_extraction.source_updated_at: null because TMDB movie details does not expose a source update timestamp
tmdb_extraction.forbidden_field_boundary: raw transport responses may contain TMDB response fields, but no forbidden field may be copied into structured features, embedding input text, or preference artifacts

embedding.batching: stable sort by input character length, encode, then restore movie_id order; batching must not change tokenization or vectors beyond floating point tolerance

transport.embedding_checkpoint: memory-mapped float32 array plus model/input/batch signature after every embedding batch

pass_conditions: sample identity, structured, and text coverage each meet the corresponding full-run health threshold without claiming statistical full-gate evidence
resume reuses successful cache without a network request
retry and terminal response behavior covered by unit tests
every eligible embedding has dimension 384 and L2 norm within tolerance
token and forbidden preference fields absent from generated feature artifacts
